save_data: save arbitrary Python data as a PyTorch .pth file under a unique debug uid
load_data: load previously saved PyTorch .pth data by uid and name with optional CPU mapping
list_all_names: list all saved data names for a given debug uid in the default debug directory
load_all_data: load all saved .pth data files for a given debug uid into a dictionary
compare_data: recursively compare two data structures including dicts, lists, and PyTorch tensors
